description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Excise Notification No. 04/2022 Excise Duty on Ethyl Alcohol
reasoning: This gazette notification amends excise duty rates on ethyl alcohol through the Excise Ordinance. It contains regulatory changes to tax rates and classifications, falling under legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel/structure (Types 1-3) or other specialized categories.
